title: North Tide's Hollow

'''North Tide's Hollow'''was a region of [[Silverpine Forest]] just north of the [[Sepulcher]]. The Hollow was one of the many haunts of the evil [[Moonrage]] [[worgen]], the servants of the [[Archmage]] [[Arugal]]. These worgen set up very crude encampments in some places. These camps employed only the meanest necessities of survival needed by the tough worgen.
